name: skisphere
description: HTML5 planetarium: constellations and planets from any point on Earth

scripts.build: bun run data && bun run bundle
scripts.build:min: bun run data && bun build src/main.ts --outdir public --target browser --minify
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run verify && bun run test && bun run browser && bun run shot
